title: MessageSend
description: Command: API asks the engine to send a message from one account.

draftId.description: The draft this was written in, the key of the send: one draft goes out once. Its draft is deleted once sent, and a message that can't be sent comes back as it.

inReplyTo.description: Message-ID header of the message this answers, for the thread headers.

attachments.description: Files uploaded through the API, stored in S3 as upload/<accountId>/<id>.

html.description: An HTML version next to the text, e.g. a forwarded message with its formatting.

references.description: Message-IDs of the conversation, oldest first, for the References header.
